AI - VA - Shopify Master - Freelancer
Posted yesterday

Worldwide

Summary

We run 20+ Shopify stores powered end-to-end by AI. We are not looking for hands. We are looking for brains.
If you understand how AI works — and I mean really work with it, not just talk about it — keep reading. If you don't, this is not for you.


Who we want:
A hungry, dedicated operator who wants a long-term cooperation, not a quick gig. Someone who learns fast, executes faster, and follows our pipelines and workflows exactly as designed. We've already built the system. Your job is to run it sharp, smart, and effective — and improve on it where you can.
You should:

Know Shopify inside and out, and know how to work smart, not hard
Be fully comfortable building and operating inside AI-driven workflows
Be accountable, active, and self-driven — we don't chase people
Respect everyone you work with. Ego stays at the door.
Move quickly. In our business, everything can be done fast if you think clearly.

How we work — and how you get paid:
Everything is result-driven. The better your results, the bigger your pay. Full transparency from day one — you'll see everything from start to profit sheets. Nothing hidden.
Your payout depends on your own results. Deliver, and your pay grows. If you're good and accountable, this becomes a long-term partnership where you earn more as we grow together. This is not fixed-salary thinking — this is profit and performance.

Do not apply if:
You need hand-holding, you can't follow a process, or you're looking for guaranteed money without delivering. We move too fast for that.

If you're smart, hungry, and want to build something long-term with a team that rewards results — show us what you've got.
